cases.title: Ten failing/slow-to-act rules on invoice create neither break nor noticeably slow the save
cases.steps: WEST customer C; time 4 POST /api/invoices (baseline); create 10 enabled ENTITY_CREATED INVOICE rules (WEST, customerId eq C) each with a SEND_EMAIL that cannot resolve (from/to SUCCESS_POC nobody holds, no fallback) and a CREATE_TASK; time 4 more POSTs; drain
cases.expected: Every save 200 with the invoice saved; median save time with rules <= baseline*2 + 300 ms; after drain each rule produced 4 tasks and the invoices are unchanged (PRD A5 "a rule can never slow down or break the user's save")
cases.actual: baseline ms 17,18,18,17 (median 18); with 10 rules ms 17,15,15,15 (median 15); statuses 200,200,200,200; tasks per rule on the 4 new invoices 4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4; invoices 200:700:UNPAID 200:700:UNPAID 200:700:UNPAID 200:700:UNPAID

cases.title: ENTITY_UPDATED fires on an invoice edit but not on its create; ENTITY_CREATED fires on create only
cases.steps: NORTH customer C; rules U (ENTITY_UPDATED) and K (ENTITY_CREATED), both INVOICE, customerId eq C, CREATE_TASK EVERY_TIME; POST invoice; drain; PATCH notes; drain
cases.expected: After create: K 1 task, U 0. After the PATCH: K still 1, U 1 (PRD A1 "fires when … created or updated")
cases.actual: after create: created-rule 1, updated-rule 0; PATCH 200; after edit: created-rule 1, updated-rule 1

cases.title: A CUSTOMER created-or-updated rule fires on customer create and again on a customer edit (EVERY_TIME)
cases.steps: Rule CUSTOMER ENTITY_CREATED_OR_UPDATED, NORTH, name:contains:<tag>, CREATE_TASK "Welcome {{Customer.Name}}" EVERY_TIME; create NORTH customer named <tag>; drain; PUT customer phone; drain
cases.expected: 1 task after create titled "Welcome <name>", 2 after the edit; tasks are on the CUSTOMER
cases.actual: after create 1 task(s) ["CUSTOMER#10 \"Welcome Cust x03tag-muklmsg87c0d\""]; PUT 200; after edit 2

cases.title: A PAYMENT-created rule saves an Email with Payment and Customer placeholders rendered
cases.steps: WEST customer C (collector wendy), invoice 1000; rule PAYMENT ENTITY_CREATED, WEST, customerId eq C, SEND_EMAIL to CUSTOMER subject "Thanks {{Customer.Name}}: {{Payment.Amount}}" body "Payment {{Payment.Number}} via {{Payment.Method}} on {{Payment.Date}}; left {{Payment.Unallocated}}"; POST payment 300 on the invoice; drain; GET /api/emails?entityType=PAYMENT&entityId=p
cases.expected: One Email row on the payment, status NOT_SENT/NOT_CONFIGURED, subject contains the customer name and 300.00, body contains "#<paymentId>", no "{{"
cases.actual: 1 email(s); status NOT_SENT; subject "Thanks X-WEST-muklmvuma392: ₹300.00"; body "Payment #8 via BANK_TRANSFER on 2026-09-28; left ₹0.00"

cases.title: Placeholders not offered at the rule's level are refused at save with the action field path
cases.steps: POST /rules: CUSTOMER rule with task title {{Invoice.Number}}; INVOICE rule with body {{Payment.Amount}}; INVOICE rule with {{Invoice.Frobnicate}}; GET /placeholders?entityType=CUSTOMER
cases.expected: 400 with fieldErrors on actions[0].title / actions[0].body / actions[0].title respectively; CUSTOMER catalogue has no Invoice/Payment group, has Customer and General (Today, Rule.Name)
cases.actual: r1 400 {"actions[0].title":"{{Invoice.Number}} is not available on customer rules"}; r2 400 {"actions[0].body":"{{Payment.Amount}} is not available on invoice rules"}; r3 400 {"actions[0].title":"Unknown placeholder {{Invoice.Frobnicate}}"}; catalogue 200 groups CUSTOMER,COMMON tokens 15

cases.title: Customer.CollectionPoc follows the primary when two people hold the role; fallback text and Rule.Name render
cases.steps: NORTH customer, Collection POCs nora (primary) and sam (secondary); MANUAL INVOICE rule, task EVERY_TIME title "{{Customer.CollectionPoc}}|{{Invoice.Notes|no notes}}|{{Rule.Name}}"; run on the invoice; make sam primary; run again
cases.expected: First title "Nora North|no notes|<rule>", second "Sam South|no notes|<rule>" (PRD A4 "a role held by several people resolves to the primary")
cases.actual: run1 SUCCEEDED; titles after run1 ["Nora North|no notes|x06-muklmxa55d9a"]; make-primary 200; run2 SUCCEEDED; titles ["Sam South|no notes|x06-muklmxa55d9a","Nora North|no notes|x06-muklmxa55d9a"]

cases.title: Condition limits: depth 4 accepted, depth 5, an empty group, 21 children and an unknown field refused with paths
cases.steps: POST /rules with nested AND groups (4 levels, 5 levels), {op:AND,children:[]}, a group of 21 leaves, a leaf "bogusField:eq:1"
cases.expected: depth 4 -> 200; others 400 with fieldErrors keyed under condition… (DESIGN §5.10.2 limits: depth ≤ 4, children 1..20)
cases.actual: depth4 200; depth5 400 {"condition.children[0].children[0].children[0].children[0]":"Groups go at most 4 deep"}; empty 400 {"condition":"A group needs at least one condition"}; 21 children 400 {"condition":"A group has at most 20 conditions"}; bogus 400 {"condition.children[1].filter":"Unknown column: bogusField"}

cases.title: AND-with-nested-OR selects exactly the matching invoices in preview and in a run
cases.steps: NORTH customer with invoices 1000, 2500, 7000; preview AND(customerId eq C, OR(total gt 5000, total lt 1500)) and AND(customerId, total gt 5000, total lt 1500); save the OR rule (MANUAL) and run it
cases.expected: OR preview matchCount 2, AND preview 0; the run creates tasks on exactly the 1000 and 7000 invoices
cases.actual: OR preview 200 matchCount 2; AND preview 200 matchCount 0; run SUCCEEDED matched 2; task invoices 26,28 want 26,28

cases.title: nora (MANAGE North, READ South) cannot restrict a task rule to South, and her unrestricted rule never fires in South
cases.steps: nora POST rule regionIds [SOUTH] (CREATE_TASK); nora POST unrestricted ENTITY_CREATED INVOICE rule with OR(customerId eq S, customerId eq N); admin creates an invoice for S (South) and for N (North); drain
cases.expected: 400 fieldErrors.regionIds naming South; unrestricted rule: task on the North invoice only (DESIGN §5.10.7: empty = every region where the owner holds the rights)
cases.actual: restricted-to-South save 400 {"regionIds":"You cannot do what this rule does in South"}; unrestricted rule tasks on invoices 30 (north 30, south 29)

cases.title: A North-only rule is invisible to West-only wendy (404, not in list or summary); sam (North) sees it but cannot run or edit it
cases.steps: nora creates rule regionIds [NORTH]; wendy GET /rules/{id}, GET /rules?filter=name:contains, GET /rules/summary before/after; sam GET, POST /run, PUT
cases.expected: wendy 404 and not listed, summary unchanged; sam GET 200, run 403, PUT 403 (DESIGN §5.10.10, §5.10.7)

cases.title: Rules list answers "which regions": regionIds narrows, a non-numeric regionIds is 400 REGION_IDS_INVALID
cases.steps: admin creates rule N (regionIds [NORTH]) and W (regionIds [WEST]) with a shared tag; GET /rules?filter=name:contains:tag with regionIds=WEST; with regionIds=abc; GET /rules/summary?regionIds=WEST vs NORTH

cases.title: A rule's promise at exactly South's PROMISE_CREATE limit applies; 0.01 above is held, the owner cannot approve it, another approver can
cases.steps: Two SOUTH customers (invoice 9000 each); admin MANUAL INVOICE rules with CREATE_PROMISE FIXED 5000 and 5000.01, run each on its invoice; admin approve the held change; sam approve it
cases.expected: 5000: effect DONE result PROMISE, promise exists. 5000.01: effect DONE result PENDING_CHANGE, no promise until approved; admin (maker/owner) approve refused 4xx; sam approve 200 and the promise then exists (PRD B2)
cases.actual: 5000: effect DONE/PROMISE, promises 5000; 5000.01: effect DONE/PENDING_CHANGE #1, promises before approval 0; owner approve 400 You cannot approve a change you requested; sam approve 200; promises after 5000.01

cases.title: Run-now validation and idempotency: >50 records, bad ids, past/too-far runAt refused; a booked run is idempotent and waits for its time
cases.steps: MANUAL rule; POST /run with 51 recordIds, ["x"], runAt now-1min, runAt now+91d; then runAt now+10min twice; then same runAt with recordIds [inv]; poll 6 s
cases.expected: 400 fieldErrors.recordIds / recordIds / runAt / runAt; first booked 202 QUEUED scheduledFor=runAt; identical repeat 200 same runId; different recordIds 202 new runId; run still QUEUED after 6 s (DESIGN §5.10.9)
cases.actual: 51 ids 400 [recordIds]; ["x"] 400 {"timestamp":"2026-09-28T01:59:19.447912Z","status":400,"error":"Validation Failed","message":"One or more fields are invalid","path":"/api/automation/rules/24/run","fieldErrors":{"recordIds[0]":"must…; past 400 [runAt]; +91d 400 [runAt]; book 202 {"runId":53,"eventId":135,"status":"QUEUED","scheduledFor":"2026-09-28T02:09:00Z"}; repeat 200 run 53; other records 202 run 54; after 6 s QUEUED

cases.title: Writes refuse a past view (AS_OF_READ_ONLY), a future asOf is AS_OF_FUTURE, and a past-date preview shows no actions
cases.steps: POST /rules?asOf=yesterday; POST /rules/{id}/run?asOf=yesterday; GET /rules?asOf=tomorrow; POST /rules/preview?asOf=yesterday
cases.expected: 400 AS_OF_READ_ONLY twice; 400 AS_OF_FUTURE; preview 200 with asOf=yesterday, record.actions null (or record null) and asOfNote "Actions are shown only for today's view" (DESIGN §5.10.9, §6.17)
cases.actual: create 400 AS_OF_READ_ONLY; run 400 AS_OF_READ_ONLY; list tomorrow 400 AS_OF_FUTURE; preview 200 asOf 2026-09-27 record null note "Actions are shown only for today's view"

cases.title: A disabled entity rule does not fire but can still be run by hand; a deleted rule is 404 and never fires again
cases.steps: NORTH customer C; ENTITY_CREATED INVOICE rule (customerId eq C) created disabled; POST invoice; drain; run now; DELETE; GET; POST /run; POST another invoice; drain
cases.expected: no task from the create; run now 202 and 1 task per matching invoice; DELETE 204; GET 404; run 404; no new task after delete
cases.actual: tasks after create while disabled 0; run now 202 SUCCEEDED; tasks 1; DELETE 204; GET 404; run after delete 404 Rule not found; tasks after delete+create 1

cases.title: maxRecordsPerRun boundaries: 0 and 5001 refused; 1 truncates a 3-record run to one action
cases.steps: POST rules with maxRecordsPerRun 0, 5001, 1 (condition customerId eq C with 3 invoices); run the valid one

cases.actual: 0 -> 400 {"maxRecordsPerRun":"must be between 1 and 5000"}; 5001 -> 400; 1 -> 200; run SUCCEEDED matched 1 truncated true; tasks 1

cases.title: Reducing the owner's grant to READ suspends the rule (OWNER_LACKS_RIGHTS), it stops acting, and Run now says to resume first
cases.steps: staff otto (E2E_REGIONAL, MANAGE/ALL North) creates ENTITY_CREATED INVOICE rule, regionIds [NORTH], customerId eq C; admin PUT otto grants to READ/ALL North; GET rule; POST invoice for C; drain; otto POST /run
cases.expected: rule status SUSPENDED, suspendedReason OWNER_LACKS_RIGHTS; no task for the new invoice; run 400 "The rule is suspended; resume it first" (DESIGN §5.10.7 proactive recheck)
cases.actual: grants PUT 200; rule status SUSPENDED reason OWNER_LACKS_RIGHTS detail "OTTO-MUKLNMCLB7AD no longer holds TASK_MANAGE, which the rule needs"; tasks after invoice 0; otto run 400 "The rule is suspended; resume it first"
